correctness.rationale: First-principles cap integration gives an exactly diagonal five-by-five regional Gram matrix on a globally orthogonal pure quadratic basis. All eigenvalue branches, all six factored differences and the trace identity were reconstructed symbolically from the standalone checker. Positivity and strict ordering hold on the entire prescribed c interval by sign analysis; both crossings and multiplicities are exact, not extrapolated. Seven direct cap quadratures corroborate the formulas; their finite nature is explicitly limited.

value.rationale: For the first nontrivial scalar harmonic degree, two separated non-antipodal sensing caps yield a natural full regional observability spectrum and complete classification of worst- and best-observed modes. The minimum eigenspace changes from dimension one through three to dimension two at the exact aperture \(\sqrt5/3\); there is a further middle crossing at \(\sqrt{11/15}\). These explain a genuine stability transition and the sharp Gram condition-number divergence as caps shrink, not merely a sample computation or change of notation.
